deywós-kʷe wéwked: "h₂ówyoms ḱwóns-kʷe kʷr̥néwmi." h₃rḗḱs tom ǵʰéwtorm̥ h₁eyḗd dʰéh₁tum: "súHnus ǵn̥h₁yetōd". só ǵʰéwtōr deywóm wérunom h₁yéǵeto, tósmey-kʷe h₁yeh₂ǵsyéti ǵʰéwtōr: "h₃rḗḱs, tewe súHnus h₁ésti, ǵn̥h₁yetōd." tód h₃rḗḱs ḱekluwṓs deywóm wérunom bʰéwdʰeto.

owis nu eḱwobʰyos ewewkʷet: "kēr aghnutai moi eḱwons agontm̥ nerm̥ widn̥tei." eḱwōs ewewkʷont: "kludʰi owi, kēr aghnutai n̥smei widn̥tbʰyos: ner, potis, owiomkʷe wl̥Hnām sebʰei gʷʰermom westrom kʷr̥neuti; owiomkʷe wl̥Hnā ne esti." tod kekluwōs owis agrom bʰugēt.

só h₃rḗḱs súHnum wl̥h₁néto, n̥ gʷʰénos h₁ést. tósyo ǵʰéwtorm̥ só prēḱst: "súHnus moy ǵn̥h₁yetōd!" ǵʰéwtōr wewkʷed: "deywóm wérunom h₁yáǵeswo, tód tói dʰéh₁ti." só h₃rḗḱs deywóm h₁yaǵét, wérunom-kʷe h₁éweh₁eti.

owis nu eḱwobʰyos ewewkʷe: "kēr aghnutai moi eḱwons agontn̥s nerm̥ widn̥tei." eḱwōs ewewkʷont: "kludʰi owi, kēr aghnutai n̥smei widn̥tbʰyos: ner, potis, owiom-kʷe wl̥nām sebʰei gʷʰermom westrom kʷr̥neuti; owiom-kʷe wl̥nā ne esti." tod kekluwōs owis agrom bʰugēt.

h₂ówis nu h₁éḱwoybʰyos wewkʷé: "ḱḗr moi h₂egʰnutor, h₁éḱwoms h₂égontm̥ nérm̥ wídn̥tei." h₁éḱwōs wewkʷónt: "ḱludʰí, h₂ówi, ḱḗr h₂egʰnutor n̥smé wídn̥tbʰyos: nḗr, potis, h₂ówyom-kʷe h₂wl̥h₁náh₂m sébʰei gʷʰermóm wéstrom kʷr̥néwti; h₂ówyom-kʷe h₂wl̥h₁náh₂ né h₁esti." tód ḱekluwṓs h₂ówis h₂ágrom bʰugét.

awis nu akwabʰjas awawkʷat: "kard agʰnutai mai akwams agantam narm wajdntai." akwāsas awawkʷant: "kludʰi awai, kard agʰnutai nsmai wajdntbʰjas: nar, patis, awjām-kʷe warnām sabʰai gʷʰarmam wastram kʷrnawti; awjām-kʷe warnā na asti." tad kakluwās awis agram bʰawgat.
bʰráter, ḱléwos h₁ésti h₁ónomn̥ n̥ḿ̥tom, kʷod wiHrṓ mr̥tṓ-kʷe ḱlunti.
h₂ṓ, ḱarós, h₁yéḱʷlos... né: kʷ(ʰ)ékʷlos moi h₂ŕ̥h₂t. ḱarós, kʷékʷlom h₁ésti toi? h₁éh₁, ést moi kʷékʷlos.
snusé, h₁éǵ ḱlúwmi: nḗr tóm dwórom h₁sth₂éti. tóm né h₁léikʷe; h₂ówim péḱʷe!
ḱaré, h₁ékwos h₂ówyōm-kʷe pécu tód h₂ágrom h₁ésti; h₂ágrei h₁ésti.
h₁éǵ h₁éḱwom wesnéh₂mi... ḱaré, né: h₁éḱwom wesnéh₂mi — h₁éḱwos moi wésno h₁ésti.
dʰugh₂tér, sh₂ówl̥ h₂ésto-n̥ h₁éyti: h₂ówsōs h₁ésti, sh₂ówl̥ nḗ-mn̥ h₁éyti, nokʷts-kʷe h₁éyti ḱew ǵʰmónt.
súnu, h₂árh₃trom ǵʰer! dwoh₁ gʷṓu h₂árh₃trei yéwge!
ḱaré, h₁éh₁, h₂ówim h₁eidh₁om... h₂ówis wóida: h₂ówis h₁eǵ h₁eidóm; h₂ágrei h₁ésti.

English: Daughter-in-law, a man is standing at the door. Do not leave him. Cook a sheep!

English: Mother, where is father?

English: Did you make the spear?

kʷís dʰwéri stéh₂ti?
English: Who is standing at the door?

kéh₂re, h₃ówim-ne dédorḱta?
English: Dear one, have you seen the sheep?

swésor, h₁n̥gʷnís-ne dʰégʷʰeti?
English: Sister, is the fire burning?

kéh₂re, h₁éḱwom wesnéh₂si? kʷósyo h₁ésti?
English: Dear one, you are buying the horse? Whose is it?

swésor, séh₂ h₂wĺ̥h₁neh₂ kʷéso h₁ésti?
English: Sister, whose wool is this?

h₁éde h₁emé dómi, h₁ibʰi-kʷe píbe!
English: Eat in my house, and drink there!

kéh₂re, kʷu pékus h₁ésti?
English: Dear one, where is the flock?

wiHré, kʷós póntoh₂s h₃rēǵós dóm h₁éyti?
English: Man, which road goes to the king's house?

sūnu, h₂érh₃trom dʰérh₁e! dwóh₁ gʷōu h₂érh₃troi yéuǵe.

dʰugh₂ter, kʷó séh₂wl̥ h₁éyti?
English: Daughter, where does the sun go?

Give us great fame! Gloss: n̥sméy = to us (dat. 1pl); méǵh₂ = great (neuter acc.); ḱléwos = fame, glory (acc.); dʰedʰh₁dʰí = give! (reduplicated imperative, 2sg).
They killed the snake. Gloss: égʷʰent = they struck/killed (3pl past, augmented); ógʷʰim = snake (acc. sg.).

A king wished for a son. He asked his priest: "May a son be born to me!" The priest said to that king: "Sacrifice to the god Varuna." Gloss: h₃rḗḱs = king; súHnum = son (acc.); wl̥nh₁to = wished/desired (3sg middle past); tósyo = his (gen.); ǵʰéwtorm̥ = priest (acc.); prēḱst = asked; súHnus = son (nom.); moy = to me; ǵn̥h₁yetōd = let be born (3sg middle imperative); ǵʰéwtōr = priest (nom.); tom = that (acc.); h₃rḗǵm̥ = king (acc.); wewked = said; h₁yáǵeswo = sacrifice! (2sg middle imperative); deywóm = god (acc. pl./gen. pl.); wérunom = Varuna (acc.).
Good fame. Gloss: wésu = good (neuter); ḱléwos = fame, glory.

A sheep that had no wool saw horses: one pulling a heavy wagon, one carrying a big load, one carrying a man quickly. Gloss: owis = sheep; yāi = to whom/on whom; wl̥nā = wool; ne = not; eest = was; dedorḱe = saw (perfect); eḱwons = horses (acc. pl.); tom = that/one; woǵʰom = wagon (acc.); gʷr̥um = heavy; weǵʰontm̥ = pulling/carrying (acc. participle); bʰorom = load, burden; meǵm̥ = great; ǵʰm̥onm̥ = man (acc.); ōku = quickly; bʰerontm̥ = carrying (acc. participle).
Let our word go forth. Gloss: wékʷos = word (nom./acc. n.); nos = our/us (enclitic); pró = forth, forward; h₁éytu = let it go (3sg imperative).
Vigorous strength (a strong spirit). Gloss: ish₁róm = vigorous, strong (adj.); ménos = spirit, mind, mental force.
Give us imperishable fame! Gloss: ń̥dʰgʷʰitom = imperishable, unfailing (acc./neuter); nos = to us (enclitic); ḱléwos = fame; dʰedʰh₁dʰí = give! (imperative 2sg).

"I want a son." "Let it be so," said the bright god Varuna. Then the king's wife gave birth to a son. Gloss: súHnum = son (acc.); wēlh₁mi = I wish; tód = that, it; h₁estu = let it be; wéwked = said; lewkós = bright; deywós = god; wérunos = Varuna; nu = now/then; h₃réḱs = king's (of the king); pótnih₂ = wife, mistress; súHnum = son (acc.); ǵeǵonh₁e = gave birth to (perfect).
He is a king; he is childless. Gloss: h₃rḗḱs = king; h₁est = is; só = he, that one; n̥putlós = childless.
Lie slain! (Slain ones, lie down!) Gloss: gʷʰn̥tṓs = slain, killed (nom. pl. participle); ḱéydʰwe = lie (down) (2pl imperative).

"Hear me, father Varuna!" The god Varuna came, hundreds from the sky. Gloss: ḱludʰí = hear! (imperative); moi = me; pter = father (voc.); werune = Varuna (voc.); deywós = god; wérunos = Varuna; diwés = of the sky/day; km̥tá = hundreds; gʷah₂t = came.

What do you want? Gloss: kʷíd = what; wēlh₁si = you wish (2sg).

Dear name; beloved name. Gloss: priHóm = dear, beloved (acc./neuter); h₁nómn̥ = name.
Let bone grow (together) with bone. Gloss: h₃ésth₁ = bone (nom./acc.); h₃sth₁éh₁ = from/with bone (abl./inst.); h₁léwdʰetu = let it grow (3sg imperative).
He drives the cattle. Gloss: h₂éǵet = he drives, leads (3sg present); gʷṓs = cows, cattle (acc. pl.).

Let them overcome him, let them lift him up, and let them put him under their own feet. Gloss: tóm = him (acc.); títr̥h₂n̥tu = let them overcome; udʰh₁éntu = let them set up/raise; tóm-kʷe = and him; swóysu = in/among their own (loc. pl.); pedsú = feet (loc. pl.); dʰh₁éntu = let them put.

The sheep that had no wool saw the horses. Gloss: tod = that/the (neuter, relative-like); ḱeḱruwos = (one who) has no wool/shorn?; owis = sheep; aǵrom = field; ebʰuget = fled. Free translation: The sheep that was shorn fled to the field.
